messages:
alex: Morning handoff — quick sync from my side. Current state: embed-service saw a 5xx spike for ~18m starting ~06:12 UTC, error rate peaked at ~4%. We rolled traffic to replica pool, evicted a couple of hot KV entries as a mitigation. No user-facing customer alerts yet.
maria: Thanks. Root cause suspected GC pause on the older p4d nodes running quantized-ggml variant. I scaled the pool +2 and pinned new requests to p4d-v2. Latency dropped back to baseline.
cheng: Noted. I pushed a small hotfix to the eviction logic to avoid mass evictions — PR #4821. Can someone do a quick review so we can merge and ship?
samir: I'm on it, will review now. Quick heads-up: there's an unrelated redis auth flake in staging that might affect the KV warmup job. I filed a ticket: INF-783.
Tess: @samir can you add repro steps? Also we should schedule a follow-up to validate cache warming after PR merges.
samir: Yep, added steps + logs to INF-783. Repro uses `curl` to hit `/kv/warmup` with a small payload.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot posted: Deploy succeeded for embed-service/quantized-ggml @ 1945679123 :white_check_mark:
maria: After routing to p4d-v2 we saw a sustained drop in 5xx. Still want to validate root cause — GC logs look noisy around the spike window. I'll collect heap profiles and upload to the incident doc.
ach:
alex: Action items: 1) @cheng finalize PR #4821 and add a unit test for eviction boundary. 2) @maria upload heap profiles + timeline to the incident doc. 3) @samir continue with INF-783 and try a warmup run on staging after PR is merged. 4) @tess coordinate a 1-hour postmortem sync if root cause confirmed.
cheng: Will add the test and ping for review in ~30m.
maria: Uploading profiles now — link: https://internal.redwood/incident/1945678910/heap-profiles :point_up:
samir: Quick check — if we rerun the cache warmup, do we want to throttle concurrency? It was previously at 50/worker which might be too aggressive.
tess: Throttle to 8/worker for staging warmup. For prod, we'll coordinate with eng-sre.
alex: Also small housekeeping: I added a temporary alert suppression for noisy GC errors to avoid noisy paging during investigation. Remove once we confirm mitigation.
cheng: PR #4821 ready for review. pinging @samir @tess for quick pass.
samir: Reviewed, left one comment about race on async eviction. I'll follow up if needed.
tess: I'll schedule the postmortem for 1500 UTC today and invite the relevant folks. Tentative agenda: timeline, root cause evidence, action items, rollback/runbook updates.
alex: Thanks all. If anything urgent, DM me. Otherwise I'll hand off to the evening shift. :thumbsup:
